research_question: Among Eaton structures with street-overhead ordinal-severity disagreement, does damaged-component dominance together with view-specific damage assessability predict the signed disagreement direction?
claim_scope: Same-event spatial association and image-evidence explanation; not a causal field-truth, external-event, routing, or deployable-selector claim.
analysis_unit: one media-only canonical street-overhead pair per DINS structure
canonical_pair_rule: retain only readable, non-constant, EXIF-orientation-1 street-overhead pairs with an ordinal source label
within each DINS structure choose maximum street-image pixel area
break ties by smallest numeric attachment_id, then lexical pair_id

spatial_protocol.constant_media_exclusion_rule: exclude an image when every RGB channel has zero within-image dynamic range
spatial_protocol.orientation_exclusion_rule: exclude an image when EXIF Orientation is present and is not 1 so model and human viewers cannot see different rotations
spatial_protocol.media_dependency_rule: assign connected components of spatial blocks linked by an exact street or overhead SHA-256 as indivisible split groups

models.ensemble_rule: mean of per-seed temperature-calibrated class probabilities within each view, then argmax

annotation.selection_rule: all unique pairs with ensemble street-overhead disagreement in the named role; selection never uses signed direction
blind_fields: embedded EXIF, XMP, IPTC, or text metadata including GPS, capture time, device, and camera direction

codebook.task_scope: Judge only evidence visible in the supplied paired images. Do not infer hidden field truth, use location metadata, or consult external records.

component_scope.roof: roof plane, covering, ridge, and roof structural loss
component_scope.facade: vertical envelope including exterior walls, siding, windows, and doors

dominance_definitions.roof: Visible damage evidence is predominantly on roof components.
dominance_definitions.facade: Visible damage evidence is predominantly on facade components.
dominance_definitions.mixed: Both roof and facade show substantive damage and neither can be assigned clear dominance.
dominance_definitions.none_detected: No roof or facade damage can be identified in the supplied image evidence; this is not a field-truth no-damage claim.
dominance_definitions.unknown: Coverage, occlusion, scale, or quality prevents a reliable dominance judgment.

codebook.assessability_definition: Whether one named view contains enough coverage and quality to judge the damage state of the named component; assessability is not damage presence.

assessability_state_definitions.assessable: The component has sufficient coverage and image quality for a damage-state judgment.
assessability_state_definitions.not_assessable: The component is out of frame, occluded, too small, or too poor quality for a damage-state judgment.
assessability_state_definitions.indeterminate: The rater cannot reliably decide between assessable and not_assessable.

boundary_rules: Eaves at the roof-wall boundary do not alone establish roof or facade dominance; use mixed or unknown unless the broader damage pattern resolves dominance.
Total structural loss is mixed unless surviving evidence clearly localizes the dominant damaged component.
none_detected and unknown must never be merged.
Each rater works independently and cannot see the other rater's answers.

primary_estimand.name: H-B1 severity-standardized directional contrast
primary_estimand.definition: P(remote_prediction > street_prediction | mechanism-eligible roof disagreement) minus P(remote_prediction > street_prediction | mechanism-eligible facade disagreement)
primary_estimand.severity_standardization: standardize both component strata to the frozen native-severity distribution

supportive_estimands: mechanism eligibility coverage among all disagreements
full-disagreement explained fraction = coverage times direction-consistent share

power_simulation.data_generating_process: For each observed spatial_block_id by mechanism stratum, draw a beta-distributed block probability with the frozen stratum mean and ICC, then draw one Bernoulli direction per observed eligible pair while retaining its frozen target and block.
power_simulation.success_event: severity-standardized H-B1 95% whole-block bootstrap lower bound is greater than zero with common severity support

prohibited_substitutes: DINS construction, material, presence, or exposure attributes as damage dominance
VLM or model-generated component labels as human reference
seed rows treated as independent observations
spatial_confirmation scoring before model, annotation, estimator, and hash commitment
next-view selection, routing, stop/defer, or report-generation claims
